prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One single premium illustrated plush animal game piece, for a gentle storybook village sorting game. Input is style/palette reference only. A friendly front-facing standing stuffed toy, full body head to feet, soft rounded cuddly silhouette, beautifully crafted fabric with subtle cloth texture, tiny seam details, warm soft painted shading. Very clean silhouette and face readable at 50px. Neutral open eyes, tiny embroidered smile, short arms, stout body, NOT realistic fur, no 3D plastic, no harsh black outline, no neon or glow. No background, genuine transparent alpha, no extra props, no platform, no shadow backdrop. Portrait 2:3 canvas, animal centered with consistent top and bottom safe margins 5%. Empty cream tummy, no number or letters or signs. Keep both feet fully visible. Species: fox. Fabric color: warm caramel orange. A simple sage green scarf tied around neck. Same scale and front-view proportions as a collectible set of eight.
